signals.text: Revenue grew 7% a year over 3 years vs 8% over 5: growth is steady.
Profit compounded at 16% vs revenue at 7%: operating leverage is showing.
Operating margin expanded 475 bps in 3 years (24.8% → 29.6%).
Working-capital days lengthened by 263 days in 3 years (38 → 301).
Over 5 years, operating cash flow was 144% of reported profit: profits are turning into cash.

flags.text: Working-capital days lengthened by 263 days in 3 years (38 → 301).

guidance.statement: Management expects double-digit revenue growth in the range of 10% to 12% minimum for FY27.
guidance.quote: As far as revenue growth is concerned, we are hopeful that we'll be maintaining a double-digit growth in the current financial year '26-'27.

guidance.statement: EBITDA margin is expected to be maintained around 30% to 31% in FY27.
guidance.quote: And the EBITDA margin, we have always maintained around 30%, 31%, and it will be maintained.

guidance.statement: HAL plans to deliver around 20 LCA Mark-1A aircraft during the current financial year.
guidance.quote: So we are planning to deliver around 20 LCA. I'm not telling that it may happen in this quarter, next quarter, or the last quarter. But this financial year, we are planning to deliver this many aircraft.

guidance.statement: The company expects to receive orders of INR90,000 crores, including ROH orders, during the next 2 years.
guidance.quote: In total, we expect to receive orders of INR90,000 crores, including the ROH orders, during the next 2 years.

guidance.statement: HAL plans to invest around INR12,000 crores in various manufacturing infrastructure projects by 2030.
guidance.quote: We plan to invest around INR12,000 crores in these projects by 2030.

guidance.statement: The company plans to deliver around 20 plus HTT-40 aircraft this financial year.
guidance.quote: And we are planning around 20 plus this year to deliver. And every year, it continues because now we have 2 lines

delivered.statement: Achieved revenue from operations of INR33,050 crores for FY25-26, an increase of 7% YoY.
EBITDA grew by 11% to reach INR13,472 crores with operating EBITDA at 30% of revenue.
Reported profit before tax of INR12,112 crores, an increase of 12% compared to previous year.
Invested INR2,386 crores in capex during FY25-26.
Spent INR2,794 crores in R&D activities, which is around 8.4% of revenue.
Fresh orders received during the year stood at INR97,028 crores, taking order book to INR2,54,538 crores.

calls.tone: confident on demand, double-digit growth, and margin sustainability, while navigating supply chain headwinds.

pushback.gist: Analysts pressed on repeated timeline extensions and the reasons holding up the delivery of ready LCA aircraft.
Questioned whether global supply chain disruptions and engine/component delays affect execution timelines for major platforms.
Inquired how 30-31% margins will be maintained as manufacturing share rises and input costs increase.
Asked about the core issues behind GE engine delivery variability despite past commitments.

business.summary: HAL is a strategic aerospace and defense organization engaged in the manufacturing, repair, and overhaul (ROH) of aircraft, helicopters, engines, and related systems for military and civil customers.

segments.name: Manufacturing
segments.note: Manufacturing of aircraft, helicopters, and engines.

guidance.statement: Management expects revenue growth of 8% to 10% for the current year.
guidance.quote: The guidance is 8%-10%, and it may so happen a double-digit growth from next year onwards.

guidance.statement: EBITDA margin at the operating level will be maintained around 31%.
guidance.quote: So, we will be maintaining 31% at operating level.

guidance.statement: A comprehensive capex plan of Rs. 14,000 to Rs. 15,000 crores is planned for the next five years.
guidance.quote: We have formulated a comprehensive CAPEX plan for the next five years, with an estimated outlay of Rs. 14,000 to Rs. 15,000 crore.

guidance.statement: GE has confirmed the supply of 12 engines for LCA Mark 1A in the calendar year up to December.
guidance.quote: GE has promised a supply of 12 engines in this calendar year up to December.

guidance.statement: Order pipeline of around Rs. 1 lakh crores is expected to materialize within one to two years.
guidance.quote: The aggregate value of the order pipeline is estimated at around Rs. 1 lakh crores and are expected to materialize within the next one to two years.

delivered.statement: Turnover increased by 7% over the previous year to Rs. 30,105 crores.
Achieved profits before tax of Rs. 10,820 crores, representing 35% of revenue.
Received new orders aggregating Rs. 1,25,280 crores during the year.
Order book of the company improved to Rs. 1,89,300 crores.

calls.tone: Confident on demand and long-term order visibility, with conservative near-term revenue guidance.

pushback.gist: Analysts questioned why revenue growth is guided at only 8%-10% despite a massive order book and resolution of LCA bottlenecks.
Concerned whether sharp manufacturing scaling and phase-out of old platforms would negatively impact MRO revenues.
Pressed on the resolution timeline for the grounded ALH fleet for the Navy and Coast Guard.

guidance.statement: Annual capex is estimated at around 3,000 crores over the next 5 years.
guidance.quote: The CAPEX plan for the next 5 years is estimated to be somewhere between 14,000 to 15,000 crores which translates into an average CAPEX of almost 3,000 crores on annual basis.

guidance.statement: Manpower cost as a percentage of revenue is expected to drop to 16% in FY25.
guidance.quote: we expected to bring it down to further to 16% of revenue in the current financial year.

guidance.statement: Around 47,000 crores of orders are expected to materialize in the next 6 months to 1 year.
guidance.quote: We expect almost 47,000 crores of orders to materialize in this 1-year timeframe.

guidance.statement: Outstanding order book is expected to reach around 1,20,000 crores by March 31, 2025.
guidance.quote: we expect the outstanding order book position to be somewhere around 1,20,000 crores even after liquidation

guidance.statement: Anticipated pipeline orders aggregate around 1,60,000 to 1,70,000 crores over 18 months to 3 years.
guidance.quote: The aggregate value of all these orders is expected to be somewhere around 1,60,000 to 1,70,000 crores and our expectation it will all materialize in the next 18 months to 3 years’ time frame.

guidance.statement: EBITDA margins are expected to range between 29% and 33% over the next 2-3 years.
guidance.quote: at the minimum level it should be not less than 29%... should be somewhere around 32% to 33%.

guidance.statement: Manufacturing revenue growth is expected to be around 15% to 18% annually.
guidance.quote: the manufacturing growth definitely it has to be around 15% to 18% growth has to be there every year.

guidance.quote: And the repair and overall growth of around 9% to 10% growth, we will be able to sustain

delivered.statement: Revenue from operations reached 30,381 crores in FY24, registering a 13% increase.
Manpower cost as a percentage of revenue rationalized to 17% in FY24.
Overhead expenditure to revenue percentage was brought down to 4.66% in FY24.
Outstanding order book stood at 94,000 crores as of May 2024.
Delivered 5 LCA aircraft and 6 ALH helicopters during FY24.
Development sales reached around 1,500 crores, accounting for about 5% of total revenue in FY24.

calls.tone: Confident on robust order book, strong delivery pipeline, and sustained double-digit growth.

pushback.gist: Analysts questioned the drivers behind the surge in gross margins above 60% in Q4.
Analysts questioned if supply chain challenges would hinder the delivery target of 16 LCA Mark 1As.
An analyst raised concerns that LCA Mark 1A weight is higher than competing aircraft like the Gripen.
An analyst requested more frequent earnings calls, moving to semi-annual or quarterly interactions.

guidance.statement: Management targets double-digit revenue growth of 10% from FY25 onwards.
guidance.quote: we will be able to reach a double-digit growth of 10% from '24-'25 onwards.

guidance.statement: EBITDA margin will settle down at 26% to 27% going forward.
guidance.quote: We will settle down at 26%, 27%.

guidance.statement: Estimated order value of INR48,000 crores to get concluded in the coming financial year.
guidance.quote: So we expect estimated order value of almost INR48,000 crores to get concluded in the coming financial year, which means within a time span of 6 to 10 months.

guidance.statement: Revenue growth for the current financial year is expected to be single-digit.
guidance.quote: And the current financial year also, we have been maintaining that it will be a single-digit growth only

guidance.statement: Expects breakthrough export order to happen in the next 1 year timeframe.
guidance.quote: we are awaiting one breakthrough order to happen, which we are very positive, it should happen in the next 1 year timeframe.

delivered.statement: Reached record revenue of almost INR26,900 crores, registering growth of over 9%.
PBT increased by almost 24% to approximately INR6,500 crores.
PAT growth was quite substantial at around 14%.
EBITDA for the year stood at around 31% of revenues.
Order book stands at a healthy approximately INR82,000 crores after liquidating INR26,000 crores.
Received INR2,451 crores as tax refund and INR830 crores as interest over the last two years.

calls.tone: confident on long-term demand and growth trajectory, cautious on near-term single-digit growth and unsustainable EBITDA highs.

pushback.gist: Analysts asked about potential delays in the LCA Mk1A delivery schedule.
Analysts questioned the impact of recent ALH groundings and accidents on future orders and design safety.
Asked about potential challenges and delays in signing the TOT contract for GE F414 engines for LCA Mk2.
Analysts observed a decline in PAT in the fourth quarter compared to the corresponding period.

guidance.statement: Achieving higher production rates for LCA Mk1A, targeting 24+ aircraft annually in coming years.
guidance.quote: Achieving higher production rates for LCA Mk1A (targeting 24+ aircraft annually in coming years).

guidance.statement: Enhancing indigenisation levels, aiming 65-75%+ for major platforms.
guidance.quote: Enhancing indigenisation levels (aiming 65-75%+ for major platforms).

Profit After Tax (PAT) increased by 9% to ₹9,07,567 Lakh in FY26.
Order book stood at ₹2,54,53,848 Lakh as on March 31, 2026.
Incurred Capital Expenditure (CAPEX) of ₹2,46,535 Lakh in FY 2025-26.

calls.tone: Positive and confident, driven by strong order visibility, indigenisation focus, and robust financial performance.
